content_sanskrit: भूपीठेन सता तत्र मया तदनु मानव । अनुभूतं नदनदीस्वसंवेदनसंस्थितेः
padaccheda: भूपीठेन । सता । तत्र । मया । तदनु । मानव । अनुभूतम् । नदनदीस्वसंवेदनसंस्थितेः
anvaya: मानव ! तदनु सता मया तत्र भू-पीठेन नद-नदी-स्वसंवेदन-संस्थितेः अनुभूतम् (अस्ति) ।
meaning_english: O human! Subsequently, existing there as the surface of the earth, I experienced the subjective sensations and states of rivers and streams.
In some places, I felt the pitiful agony of women wailing due to death, while in others, I experienced the great joy of grand festivals featuring the vigorous dancing of women.
In one place, I witnessed the wretchedness of unstoppable famine and miserable cries; in another, the deep friendliness and prosperity brought by an abundance of all types of crops.
In some parts, I felt the fierce pain of bodies being burnt in massive conflagrations, and in others, I saw cities, towns, and villages being torn asunder by floods.
Somewhere, I experienced regions being plundered by volatile vassals, and elsewhere, circles of demons and ghosts engaged in unrestrained wickedness.
I felt the quivering delight of reservoirs with rippling surfaces like bristling hair, and saw clouds tossed by winds emerging from the depths of caves.
I experienced the earth's surface with its hair-like sprouts rising like bodily bristles due to conscious awakening, and its terrain appearing uneven and shimmering due to the agitation of clouds.
I experienced a landscape filled with peaks, fearsome chasms, cities, mountains, forests, and towns, along with gentle tremors marked by lines of movement within the sphere of consciousness.
In one place, I felt the slaughter of armies agitated by vassals in battle; in another, the peaceful assembly of all vassals sitting in comfort.

padaccheda: अरण्यम् । क्वचित् । आशून्यम् । उल्लसद्वातझंकृति । जंगलम् । क्वचित् । आलूनव्युप्तसंपन्नसस्यकम्
anvaya: क्वचित् उल्लसत्-वात-झंकृति आ-शून्यम् अरण्यम् (अनुभूतम्) क्वचित् आलून-व्युप्त-संपन्न-सस्यकम् जंगलम् (अनुभूतम्) ।
meaning_english: In some areas, I experienced desolate forests echoing with the whistling of blowing winds, and in others, fertile lands rich with harvested and sown crops.
In some places, this world appears as a lake filled with swans and kāraṇḍava ducks and blooming lotuses; in others, it is a desert with thick pillars of dust raised by the winds amidst arjuna trees.

In some parts, there is the gurgling sound of rivers and streams flowing effortlessly and rubbing against their banks; in others, there is the sprouting of seeds moistened to manifest the form of a sprout.

content_sanskrit: क्वचिदन्तस्तु कीटास्यमृदुस्पन्दनवेदनम् । मां त्वमेवाशु बुद्ध्वेह त्रायस्वेतीव बोधनम्
padaccheda: क्वचित् । अन्तः । तु । कीटआस्यमृदुस्पन्दनवेदनम् । माम् । त्वम् । एव । आशु । बुद्ध्वा । इह । त्रायस्व । इति । इव । बोधनम्
anvaya: क्वचित् तु अन्तः कीट-आस्य-मृदु-स्पन्दन-वेदनम्, 'इह माम् त्वम् एव आशु बुद्ध्वा त्रायस्व' इति इव बोधनम् (अस्ति) ।
meaning_english: Somewhere, there is the internal sensation of the gentle throbbing of an insect's mouth, appearing as if it were a plea saying, 'Having known me here, please save me quickly.'

padaccheda: शाखापरिकराभोगम् । मृद्भागाङ्गनिपीडनैः । मूलजालम् । अवष्टभ्य । क्वचित् । विटपधारिणम्
anvaya: क्वचित् मृद्-भाग-अङ्ग-निपीडनैः मूल-जालम् अवष्टभ्य शाखा-परिकर-आभोगं विटप-धारिणम् (अस्ति) ।
meaning_english: In certain places, the world takes the form of a tree supporting its branches, having firmly grasped the network of roots through the pressure of its limbs within the earth.

padaccheda: अन्योन्यम् । अलम् । आक्रम्य । दिक्तटाङ्गनिपीडनैः । क्वचित् । अद्रिअस्थिनिबिडैः । अर्णवोल्लासवेल्लितम्
anvaya: क्वचित् अद्रि-अस्थि-निबिडैः दिक-तट-अङ्ग-निपीडनैः अन्योन्यम् अलम् आक्रम्य अर्णव-उल्लास-वेल्लितम् (अस्ति) ।
meaning_english: In some regions, it is tossed by the surging of the oceans, where the massive mountain-bones press against the edges of the quarters, powerfully encroaching upon one another.

padaccheda: शुष्कपल्लवसंकोचनिबिडाङ्गनिपीडनम् । अमर्षणैः । करैः । आर्कैः । स्वरसाकर्षणम् । क्वचित्
anvaya: क्वचित् शुष्क-पल्लव-संकोच-निबिड-अङ्ग-निपीडनम्, अमर्षणैः आर्कैः करैः स्व-रस-आकर्षणम् (अस्ति) ।
meaning_english: Somewhere, there is the intense squeezing of limbs through the shrinking of dry leaves, and the extraction of one's own sap by the intolerant rays of the sun.
In certain places, there is the harsh falling of thunderbolts and trees upon the temples of mountain-dwelling elephants, despite their intense bodily strength and fierce stability.

padaccheda: निमीलितैक्षणानन्दतनूनाम् । असमाक्रमम् । क्वचित् । सूक्ष्मतरोल्लेखम् । अङ्कुरोल्लासनम् । नवम्
anvaya: क्वचित् निमीलित-ईक्षण-आनन्द-तनूनाम् असम-आक्रमम्, नवम् सूक्ष्म-तर-उल्लेखम् अङ्कुर-उल्लासनम् (अस्ति) ।
meaning_english: In some places, there is the unparalleled emergence of bodies filled with the bliss of closed eyes, and the fresh, extremely subtle manifestation of sprouting life.
Somewhere, the world resembles the dwelling of flies, lice, and mosquitoes, and the effortless dragging of the plow-like enemies against the small mountains that are like fragments of a wall.
In some parts, it is cold as if covered by shattered skin from limbs withered by frost, with water turned to stone-like ice and harsh, biting winds.

In some places, the soft limbs of the earth are broken apart, with swarms of insects sinking deep within, while in other places, the immersion in water causes the roots of limbs and plants to sprout forth.

padaccheda: शनैः । अन्तर्निलीनाम्बुकृताह्लादम् । बहिः । च । रसोन्नामाङ्कुररोमौघम् । क्वचित् । वर्षविजृम्भितम्
anvaya: शनैः अन्तः-निलीन-अम्बु-कृत-आह्लादम् बहिः च रस-उन्नाम-अङ्कुर-रोम-ओघम् क्वचित् वर्ष-विजृम्भितम् (अस्ति)।
meaning_english: The expansion of the rain slowly creates an internal delight through the water soaked within, while externally, it manifests a multitude of hair-like sprouts rising up due to the nourishing sap.

content_sanskrit: तनुतरपवनविकम्पितकोमलनलिनीदलास्तरणैः । विहरणमिव मे विहितं सरोभिरङ्गेषु निर्वाणम्
padaccheda: तनुतरपवनविकम्पितकोमलनलिनीदलास्तरणैः । विहरणम् । इव । मे । विहितम् । सरोभिः । अङ्गेषु । निर्वाणम्
anvaya: तनु-तर-पवन-विकम्पित-कोमल-नलिनी-दल-आस्तरणैः सरोभिः मे अङ्गेषु निर्वाणम् विहरणम् इव विहितम्।
meaning_english: The lakes, with their beds of tender lotus petals trembling in the very gentle breeze, have provided a state of blissful liberation to my limbs, as if offering a divine sporting ground.
